'''Star Tours Flight 814''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time and set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1D at 1635 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1730.
